subject: DSM: Error in smooth.construct.tp.smooth.spec(object, dk$data, dk$knots)

messages.author: 03c727c8ae09d0f6
messages.subject: DSM: Error in smooth.construct.tp.smooth.spec(object, dk$data, dk$knots)
parts:
Hi all,

I´m trying to run this model to estimate guanaco abundance related to x, y and number of oil wells (the same happend with EVI mean) :

dsm.est.xy.nb.ow <- dsm(abundance.est~s(x,y)+s(oil_wells), DS_HR_POLY_SIZE, segdata, obsdata, method="ML", family=nb())
summary(dsm.est.xy.nb.ow)
plot(dsm.est.xy.nb.emax) # grafico de los términos del modelo. 
par(mfrow=c(1,1))
vis.gam(dsm.est.xy.nb.emax, plot.type="contour", view=c("x","y"), asp=1, type="response", contour.col="black", n.grid=100)

R gave me this ERROR:
Error in smooth.construct.tp.smooth.spec(object, dk$data, dk$knots) : 
  A term has fewer unique covariate combinations than specified maximum degrees of freedom

Some idea about of how to solve this problem??

Thanks
Lara

messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] DSM: Error in smooth.construct.tp.smooth.spec(object, dk$data, dk$knots)
parts:
Lara

I presume this error comes during the call to the function dsm().  Do some summaries upon your segdata object to discover how many different combinations of x, y and oil_wells are in your segment data.  The message seems to suggest there are not very many distinct values of x, y, and oil_wells.  You can deduce this from your data.

You also have the option of reducing the maximum degrees of freedom (wiggliness) of your model; see examples of this in the help for function gam(), with syntax such as this 

(x0,x1,k=7)
